body: Supplement to source-derived h3 review: parent now observed a finite Windows variant on frozen OLD49ae. A root spawned a detached hidden Node helper (windowsHide:true, stdio:ignore, no vendor/GUI) that wrote only an owned temporary file after1200ms, then exited. boundedChild(timeoutMs500) returned success after46.32ms; the file appeared after return (observed at1800ms). Earlier NON-detached Windows probes did not reproduce. All fixtures were finite/owned and removed after exit. This proves success/root-close alone is not descendant settlement; it is not a claim that the inherited-stdio hang was observed. Repair worker has exact reproduction; no response PID or user process is kill authority.
